design_condition: The long volume forms a clear transition from the city to the outdoor pool and closes the peninsula, with the entrance placed at the narrowing between canal and building.

positive.statement: The building establishes a clear transition from the city to the outdoor pool and precisely closes the peninsula.
The main entrance is clearly positioned with short routes from the city and parking area.
The main functional areas are arranged in a comprehensible and clear manner.
The proposed phasing promises uninterrupted operation of the outdoor and indoor pools.
The project has a small cubage and promises an economical solution.

negative.statement: The barn image was controversially discussed as either backward-looking nostalgia or the dawn of a sustainable future.
A shell fully glazed on all sides raises questions because of the risk of glare.
The structural logic is not sufficiently conveyed; the roof structure appears fragmented and schematic.
The roof support construction fragments the impression of space.
The open-space and planting concept remains schematic and not particularly sensual.
The sunken open-topped bicycle yard appears strange, while bicycle parking is too far from the main entrance.
There is very limited space when accessing the outdoor pool.
The project contains heated rooms outside the insulation perimeter, reduced room height in the later wellness area, and undersized technical rooms.
The promised sustainable supporting structure is hardly credible at the slimness shown.
